items.question: What is the prescribed worship at the three sandhyās while reciting the vidyā?
premises: Worship is performed at three sandhyās.
The vidyā is recited during worship.
items.inference: One should worship at the three junctions while reciting the mantra and remaining self-controlled.
uncertainties: vaśī may describe the worshipper or the state of worship; exact ritual context is not specified.
items.plain_english: One should worship at the three junctions, reciting the mantra, while remaining self-controlled.
